detailed_descriptions.en: Create a Home Away from Home Looking for a place where you can just take a breath? Welcome to Hotel Galactic ! It's a tale of friendship , trust, and creating a space where everyone – no matter what corner of the galaxy they come from – feels safe. Settle on the cloud-drifting Island of Imoshima and build a hotel that will become the true heart of this world , welcoming travelers from across the endless galaxy. Who knows what story the next guest crossing your threshold will bring? Forget about cold spreadsheets or demanding management and immerse yourself in a warm, magical world to take a breath and feel truly friendly warmth. Build and Decorate Your Way With the help of your trusty crew of workers, the island will quickly fill with new rooms. Design everything from scratch: cozy guest bedrooms , spacious dining rooms filled with the smell of delicious food, game rooms with arcades, and even a relaxing spa with massage tables and a sauna! Play with styles and colors - you have a whole host of unique furniture and cozy decorations at your disposal to give the interiors exactly the vibe you want. Meet Guests from Across the Galaxy Wanderers from all kinds of fantastic races will knock on your door. Each of them has their own deep backstory, unique character, and... specific requirements. Win their appreciation by tailoring rooms to their needs. When an object they know so well from their own planet appears in their room, they'll surely feel better right away. Show them heart and hospitality, and they'll share their stories and bonds of friendship with you. The Way to the Heart is Through the Stomach What would a good hotel be without delicious food? Start a garden , take care of it, get a variety of seeds and grow cosmic plants to get ingredients that guarantee the best quality dishes served in the hotel restaurant . Cook dishes that will perfectly hit the cosmic palates of your guests, taking into account their culinary preferences. After all, nothing brings people together like a shared, warm meal! Expand Your Possibilities Discover new technologies that will help you meet hotel challenges. New styles, furniture, decorations, and even staff uniforms - it's all at your fingertips thanks to a network of merchants who are always ready to help you and provide the necessary raw materials or extra hands to work!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Create a Home Away from Home

Looking for a place where you can just take a breath? Welcome to Hotel Galactic! It's a tale of friendship, trust, and creating a space where everyone – no matter what corner of the galaxy they come from – feels safe.

Settle on the cloud-drifting Island of Imoshima and build a hotel that will become the true heart of this world, welcoming travelers from across the endless galaxy. Who knows what story the next guest crossing your threshold will bring?

Forget about cold spreadsheets or demanding management and immerse yourself in a warm, magical world to take a breath and feel truly friendly warmth.

Build and Decorate Your Way

With the help of your trusty crew of workers, the island will quickly fill with new rooms. Design everything from scratch: cozy guest bedrooms, spacious dining rooms filled with the smell of delicious food, game rooms with arcades, and even a relaxing spa with massage tables and a sauna!

Play with styles and colors - you have a whole host of unique furniture and cozy decorations at your disposal to give the interiors exactly the vibe you want.

Meet Guests from Across the Galaxy

Wanderers from all kinds of fantastic races will knock on your door. Each of them has their own deep backstory, unique character, and... specific requirements. Win their appreciation by tailoring rooms to their needs. When an object they know so well from their own planet appears in their room, they'll surely feel better right away. Show them heart and hospitality, and they'll share their stories and bonds of friendship with you.

The Way to the Heart is Through the Stomach

What would a good hotel be without delicious food? Start a garden, take care of it, get a variety of seeds and grow cosmic plants to get ingredients that guarantee the best quality dishes served in the hotel restaurant. Cook dishes that will perfectly hit the cosmic palates of your guests, taking into account their culinary preferences. After all, nothing brings people together like a shared, warm meal!

Expand Your Possibilities

Discover new technologies that will help you meet hotel challenges. New styles, furniture, decorations, and even staff uniforms - it's all at your fingertips thanks to a network of merchants who are always ready to help you and provide the necessary raw materials or extra hands to work!
